mods.name: Obsidian API
mods.summary: A library other mods build on. It does nothing by itself.
mods.description:
A library for [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mods on HELLDIVERS (2015). It gives other mods the game data by name, checked changes that can be undone, and ready actions. It does nothing by itself.

## How to use

Obsidian API comes with Obsidian, in the Obsidian Kit. Mods that need it switch it on with them.

To build on it, list it in the `obsidian.json` of the mod:

```json
"requires": ["obsidian.api"]
```

Then ask for it in the script:

```lua
local api = obsidian.import("obsidian.api")

obsidian.keybind("panic", function()
  api.player.heal()
  api.enemies.kill_near(20)
end)
```

Actions answer `true`, or `false` and a short reason such as `"host_only"`. A client mod can require the API and stay a client mod: it can read game data and use the interface, sound and event calls, and anything that changes the shared game answers `false, "needs_session"`.

[REFERENCE.md](REFERENCE.md) has every call, with guides and recipes. A copy sits in the folder of the API in the Obsidian Kit, where an AI tool working on a mod can read it.

## Known issues

- Tested solo and offline, not yet with a second player.

option_list.label: Open the menu with a controller
option_list.description: The buttons that open and close the F6 menu from a controller, pressed together. In the menu, the D-pad or the left stick moves, A selects, B goes back, Y resets a row, and LB and RB switch pages.

option_list.label: Script Profiler
option_list.description: Adds the Script Profiler page to the F6 menu: a panel over the game with the time the scripts of each mod take every frame. On its page the panel can still be hidden. Off, nothing is measured.

mods.name: Obsidian Patches
mods.summary: Small fixes and conveniences for the game.
mods.description:
Small fixes for HELLDIVERS (2015), for the [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mod manager.

Obsidian Patches removes the black bars on wide screens, skips the intro, the login screen and the planet scans, speeds up the mission end, pauses the game in solo missions, and fixes the recoil and sprint animations.

## How to use

Obsidian Patches comes with Obsidian, in the Obsidian Kit, switched on. Each fix is an option in Obsidian and takes effect at the next launch. Four of them can also be changed in game, under **Mods** in the pause menu, and apply at once.

option_list.label: Widescreen fixes
option_list.description: No black bars on screens wider than 16:9, and the objective list, dialogue boxes and galaxy map panels at the real edges of the screen.

option_list.label: Expedite mission end
option_list.description: Faster gives each results screen about a second. Instant skips to the last one. Rewards are saved either way.

option_list.label: Skip intro
option_list.description: No logos or intro video at launch.

option_list.label: Skip login screen
option_list.description: Starts on the ship, still online, with keyboard and mouse as the player 1 controls.

option_list.label: Skip war briefs
option_list.description: Hides the war briefs at login and on the galaxy map, including the updates shown as the war moves. The end of a war still plays.

option_list.label: Skip planet scanning
option_list.description: No planet discovery animation after a liberation or a new sector.

option_list.label: Dynamic solo pause
option_list.description: With a single player in the mission, the pause menu freezes the game, even in a public or friends-only lobby. The game resumes as soon as someone joins.

option_list.label: Aim cursor always visible
option_list.description: On PC, the cursor keeps the aiming look at all times, instead of dimming between shots.

option_list.label: Toggle minimap
option_list.description: The map key opens the minimap and keeps it open until pressed again, instead of only while held.

option_list.label: Weapon recoil animation fix
option_list.description: Every weapon taken in hand plays the matching recoil animation, whatever was in hand before.

option_list.label: Sprint pose fix
option_list.description: Sprinting right after getting up from a dive shows the normal running pose, instead of an upper body stuck until the sprint starts over.

versions.notes: - Changed: Expedite mission end on Instant no longer crashes the game at the end of a mission that completes a planet.
- New: the name, description and options in Russian.

- Changed: **Skip war briefs** also hides the briefs the open galaxy map plays when the war moves, such as a sector changing hands or a defend event ending. The end of a war still plays, at login too.
- Changed: **Weapon recoil animation fix** works after any weapon change, for every Helldiver in the session. A heavy support weapon, a revolver or plasma pistol shot, or a switch while aiming used to leave the next weapon with the recoil of another weapon, or none.
- Removed: **Dynamic input switch**. Keyboard, mouse and gamepad together clashed in menus such as the galaxy map.

- Changed: with **Dynamic input switch** on, logging in reaches the ship again. The join a gamepad's press asks for waited for the hold, and so did the request that adds the first player when a session starts, which left the ship without a Helldiver and returned to the main menu. Only the press waits now.

- Changed: **Widescreen fixes** also puts the mission's objective list in the top right corner of the screen and dialogue boxes (the ship's characters, briefings) at the left edge, instead of inside the 16:9 middle.
- Changed: **Widescreen fixes** also moves the galaxy map's planet panel, the planet's reward and mission panels to the screen's edges, and stretches the galaxy map's scanline overlay across the whole screen.

- Changed: going online works again. 1.9.0 sent some of the game's network messages with one value too many, which ended the session after login and returned to the main menu, with Dynamic input switch on or off.

- New: **Dynamic input switch**, off by default. With a keyboard and a gamepad connected, both control the first Helldiver and the button prompts follow the last one used; the gamepad joins as a second Helldiver only when its join button is held for 1.5 seconds, and the prompt reads HOLD instead of PRESS.
- Changed: a new image beside the mod in Obsidian's mod list.
- Changed: Sprint pose fix now frees the upper body when a sprint starts straight from standing, which is how a sprint starts after getting up from a dive, and after firing or a weapon switch too.

mods.name: Obsidian Trainer
mods.summary: An in-game menu that changes the character, gear, enemies and missions.
mods.description:
An in-game menu for HELLDIVERS (2015) that changes the character, weapons, stratagems, enemies, missions and game data, for the [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mod manager.

Missions add nothing to the save while the Trainer is on, and it stays out of the Galactic War. It offers only the base game and owned DLC.

## How to use

1. Switch on Obsidian Trainer in the Mods tab. [Obsidian API](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianAPI) turns on with it.
2. Deploy, then start the game.
3. Press **F6** to open the menu. The key can be changed in the Keys tab of Obsidian API.

The Obsidian Trainer page in the Wiki of Obsidian lists every key and page.

option_list.label: Keep saved edits
option_list.description: Applies the kept edits each time the game starts. The multiplayer check can't see them, so they belong in lobbies where everyone agreed to them.

versions.notes: - New: texts in every language for the new answers of Obsidian API 1.52.0 (no such unit, too far away, already aboard).

- New: the menu in Russian, and in Simplified Chinese from the translation by Lapeace233.
- Changed: item, weapon and enemy names show as the game writes them in every language, Cyrillic and Chinese included. Needs the next Obsidian API.

- New: Move speed while aiming and Move speed while reloading on the Player page, which let weapons that hold the player in place be walked with.
- Fixed: on a loader without `obsidian.save_data` the Mission page rows stay open, as before saves came in.
- Fixed: with the Third Person Camera mod, the rows that act at the cursor take the point under the crosshair. Needs Obsidian API 1.48.0.
- Changed: the Mission page rows that award progression (spawn and collect samples) need a Sandbox save. On an Official save they stay locked and point to the Saves tab.

- Changed: an order given on the **Bots** page stops a support weapon shot the bot started by itself, and holds those back for 8 seconds. A shot that came to nothing waits 5 seconds before the next.

All of this release's rows show in full with Obsidian API 1.38.0.
- New: each bot's page has **Weapons** (take out a weapon, the support weapon at the enemy at the cursor, the damage each weapon does to that enemy, refill the backpack), **Vehicles** (get in, take the driver's seat, get out, ride along, a mech that spares Helldivers) and **Using things** (the thing at the cursor or the nearest one, put it down, voice lines, a jump pack jump to the cursor).

- New: on the **Enemies** page, **Tell me when an enemy aims** and **Armor of the enemy**, with what each of your weapons does to it.
- Changed: a bot that can't follow an order says why in words about the bot: busy, in a seat, a seat someone else took.
- Changed: on the **Bots** page, **Help up the nearest** and **Heal the most hurt** say when another bot is already on the way to everyone who needs it. Needs Obsidian API 1.34.0.

- New: on the **Bots** page, **Help up the nearest**, **Heal the most hurt** and **Heal me** for every bot or one, and **Help each other** and **Stop helping each other** for every bot. Healing uses the REP-80 in the bot's slots. Needs Obsidian API 1.33.0.
- New: each bot's page has **Get up when downed** (on by default), **Help others up**, **Heal others** and **Stop helping**.

- Changed: **Practice mission** is now **Custom mission**, which drops into a real mission. XP, samples and unlocks count. Before, it started a training mission that paid no XP. The campaign stays as it was: no planet progress, and no Galactic War or leaderboard report.

- Changed: **Field of view**, **Camera distance** and **Camera angle** reset to the game's own values for the current screen, on the ship as in missions. They reset to a mission's values before, which left the ship's camera wrong.
- Changed: a new image beside the mod in Obsidian's mod list.

mods.name: Better HUD
mods.summary: Adds useful and configurable HUD elements: on-character ammo count, enemy and ally health bars that show status effects and damage numbers.
mods.description:
More information on the HUD of HELLDIVERS (2015), for the [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mod manager.

Better HUD counts the rounds left in the magazine and the grenades on each player card, puts health and stamina bars under the player cards and health bars over enemies, and shows damage numbers where hits land. A reload circle and an ammo circle sit beside the Helldiver. Enemy bars show burns, poison and stuns, and wait at the edge of the screen while the enemy is out of view.

## How to use

Every part can be switched on or off in the options of Better HUD in Obsidian, or in game under **Mods → Better HUD** in the pause menu. A change in one place shows in the other.

## Known issues

- Players on other computers get no stamina bar: the game keeps stamina on each player's computer and never sends it.
- Lasers and arc weapons get no round counter, since they heat or charge up instead. The ammo circle shows their heat or charge.

Mod authors can add meters, flashes and status icons to the HUD through Better HUD: see [docs/api.md](docs/api.md).

option_list.label: Ammo counter
option_list.description: Rounds left in the magazine, over the magazine count, for weapons that fire rounds. Hidden while calling a stratagem.

option_list.label: Grenade counter
option_list.description: Replaces the lower grenade icon on each player card with the number of grenades, such as x3, so counts above two show too.

option_list.label: Player health bars
option_list.description: A red bar under each player card, with a white chunk fading where health was lost and a yellow bar over it while a shield holds. After 10 seconds at full health the bar fades to grey and half opacity.

option_list.label: Health numbers
option_list.description: Current and maximum health at the right of each player bar.

option_list.label: Stamina bar
option_list.description: A thin white bar under the health bar of each player on this computer, emptying while sprinting and filling back up after. After 10 seconds full the bar fades to grey and half opacity. Players on other computers get none, as the game does not send stamina over the network.

option_list.label: Enemy health bars
option_list.description: A bar over every enemy the player hits and every heavy that any player hurts. The bar of an enemy out of view waits at the edge of the screen. In the shoulder view of Eyes of Liberty, that bar hides until the enemy is in view.

option_list.label: Reload circle
option_list.description: A ring to the left of each local Helldiver that fills while the weapon in hand reloads.

option_list.label: Ammo circle
option_list.description: A yellow ring beside each local Helldiver with the share of the magazine left, fading to red from 30% to empty. Lasers fill the ring with heat, pulsing between yellow and red from half heat, faster as it heats. Arc weapons fill it in blue with the charge, dim until the charge can fire. Empty or overheated, the ring shakes and flashes red, with the reload button inside. Shows from a shot, hides after a reload, and fades out 8 seconds after the last shot.

option_list.label: Hide on-player health bar
option_list.description: Takes away the game's own red bar over each Helldiver.

option_list.label: Hide on-player recovery bar
option_list.description: Takes away the game's own bar over a downed Helldiver getting back up.

option_list.label: Damage numbers
option_list.description: The damage dealt, where it lands: on enemies the player hits, on players losing health, or both.

option_list.label: Damage numbers mode
option_list.description: Stacked shows a number for each hit, rising out of the way at once. Accumulated adds every hit on one target into one number that stays in place and fades out, and a new one starts only once it is gone.

option_list.label: Damage numbers position
option_list.description: Above health bar needs Enemy health bars, and uses the entity spot where no bar shows. At damage instance uses the spot each hit landed.

mods.name: Photo Mode
mods.summary: A photo mode! Default F7 to open.
mods.description:
A photo mode for HELLDIVERS (2015), for the [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mod manager.

Photo Mode stops the mission, clears the HUD and hands over the camera. A panel of controls sets the lens, depth of field, filters, fog, the time of day and the sun, places up to eight lights, and poses the Helldiver. Pictures are saved to `Pictures\Helldivers`.

## How to use

Press **F7**, or pick **PHOTO MODE** in the pause menu, during a mission or on the ship. Esc or F7 leaves, and everything goes back as it was.

| Key | What it does |
|---|---|
| W A S D, Q E | Move the camera |
| Right mouse button | Look around |
| Mouse wheel | Field of view, distance or zoom |
| Shift, Alt | Faster, slower |
| Left mouse button, twice | Focus on the point under the cursor |
| P | Take a picture |
| H | Hide or show the panel |

P, H and F7 can be changed in the Keys tab of Photo Mode in Obsidian.

## Known issues

- With other players in the lobby the game keeps running, as pausing one game would split it from the others.
- In exclusive fullscreen, pictures can come out black. Borderless or windowed mode works.
- Photo Mode does not open while Third Person Camera is installed.

mods.name: Enhanced Visuals
mods.summary: Adds ambient occlusion, higher shadow resolution, supersampling, ambient light and other graphical enhancements.
mods.description:
Better graphics and extra visual effects for HELLDIVERS (2015), for the [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mod manager.

The mod turns on the ambient occlusion pass that the game ships but never runs, adds sharpening and an ambient light effect, raises the resolution and distance of sun shadows, softens shadow edges, keeps detailed models farther from the camera, and can draw the scene above the screen resolution.

## How to use

**F9** switches between Enhanced Visuals and the plain game, to compare. The key can be changed in Obsidian.

For the game textures at twice the size, see [Upscaled Textures](https://github.com/Alomare/HD1-UpscaledTextures), a separate mod that works with or without this one.

## Known issues

- Third Person Camera also uses F9: with both mods on, change one of the keys. Put Enhanced Visuals after Third Person Camera in the load order, or the shadow and render scale options do nothing.
- A shadow resolution of 8192 takes 256 MB of video memory.

option_list.label: Screen dust
option_list.description: The layer of dust that drifts across the picture on most planets.

option_list.label: Sharpening
option_list.description: Restores the fine detail that anti-aliasing softens, with less at strong edges so they don't ring. Takes effect at the next launch.

option_list.label: Ambient light
option_list.description: Deepens the dark tones and spreads a soft glow around lit areas, in place of the game's bloom. The HUD keeps the game's colors. Takes effect at the next launch.

option_list.label: Desert ambient light
option_list.description: Ambient light in daytime missions on desert planets. Off by default, as the bright sand makes the picture too bright with it. Applies at once.

option_list.label: Ambient occlusion
option_list.description: Darkens the light where surfaces meet, such as at the foot of walls and under crates and rocks.

option_list.label: Ambient occlusion affects
option_list.description: Ambient light darkens only the light from the sky, so the effect shows mostly in shade. All daylight darkens sunlight too.

option_list.label: Shadow resolution
option_list.description: The size of the sun's shadow map; larger gives sharper shadows. 8192 uses 256 MB of video memory. Takes effect at the next launch.

option_list.label: Shadow distance
option_list.description: How far from the camera the sun casts shadows. The game stops at about 20 m, which can leave the top of the screen without shadows when zoomed out. Takes effect at the next launch.

option_list.label: Shadow edges
option_list.description: Softens the hard, stepped edges of sun shadows. Takes effect at the next launch.

option_list.label: Render scale
option_list.description: Draws the scene above the screen's resolution and scales it down, for cleaner edges. 2x costs about four times the pixel work. Takes effect at the next launch.

option_list.label: Model detail distance
option_list.description: How far from the camera models keep their most detailed version.

mods.name: Eyes of Liberty
mods.summary: A third person camera that keeps other mods working.
mods.description:
A third person camera for HELLDIVERS (2015), for the [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mod manager. Formerly Unleashed Camera, and before that Integrated Third Person: remove either one when installing this mod. Based on [Third Person Camera (HD2 Style)](https://github.com/yukiorsrs/third-person-camera-helldivers) by **yukiorsrs**, rebuilt with the permission of the author so that other mods keep working beside it.

The camera follows the Helldiver over the shoulder on foot, in vehicles and on the ship. Shots, grenades and stratagems go where the crosshair points. The view reaches farther, the sky over the level is filled in, a ring around the crosshair warns of enemies close by, a bar shows where hits come from, and the edges of the screen flash red when the Helldiver is hurt. A compass at the top of the screen shows the way to the objectives found on the map. Stratagem beacons out of view show at the edge of the screen, as do allies, red while down, and a dashed line shows where a held grenade or stratagem ball would fly. The ping key marks enemies, objectives, dropped support weapons or a spot on the ground for the squad. After a death the camera stays on the body, then follows a living ally until the Helldiver is back. After extraction it rides the shuttle out.

Third Person Camera replaces 28 game scripts, so mods that change the same parts of the game stop working with it. Eyes of Liberty replaces no script: every change is a hook through Obsidian.

## How to use

**F8** switches between the top-down camera of the game and third person. **H** swaps the shoulder. The **middle mouse button** pings what the crosshair is on. The keys can be changed in Obsidian. On a gamepad, the right stick turns the camera and holding the left trigger aims; while aiming, the reload button throws grenades. A tap of the right stick swaps the shoulder. While the death cam follows allies, left and right click switch between them.

## Playing with others

The camera and everything on screen work in any lobby. Five session features change the game for the whole lobby: Ballistics revamp (every weapon reaches far, with damage falling off past the weapon's own range), Far enemy detection, Free movement, Increased throw range and Patrols stay in view. They run only when every player runs Obsidian with the same mods, and switch off when anyone else joins. With all five off, the mod counts as a client mod.

Pings show only for teammates who run the mod; nothing goes to the game's chat.

## Known issues

- Players on one computer share a screen, so the camera goes back to top-down while a second local player is in, and comes back after.
- The mod stays off while Third Person Camera, Unleashed Camera or Integrated Third Person is installed.

First person is in development for separate beta versions.

Mod authors can read the camera state through `obsidian.import("alomare.eyesofliberty")`: `active()`, `mode()`, `crosshair()` and `shoulder()`.

option_list.label: Camera mode
option_list.description: The camera at the start of the game. Default is the top-down camera of the game. The camera key switches between the two in a mission.

option_list.label: Look sensitivity
option_list.description: How fast the camera turns with the mouse or the right stick.

option_list.description: How much explosions, impacts and the Hellpod landing shake the shoulder camera.

option_list.description: When the Helldiver drops in, the camera rides down above the Hellpod looking down on it, shakes on the landing, and glides into the shoulder view once the Helldiver climbs out. The view stays still until then.

option_list.label: Death cam
option_list.description: When the Helldiver dies, the camera stays on the body, or where the body was once the game removes it, until the Helldiver drops in again or the mission ends. With allies alive, the camera moves to one of them after 4 seconds. Left and right click switch between allies, and the mouse turns the camera.

option_list.description: Once the Helldiver boards the shuttle, the camera rides with the shuttle as it takes off and flies away, until the mission ends. The mouse turns the camera.

option_list.description: The side of the Helldiver the camera sits on. The swap key, or a tap of the right stick on a gamepad, changes it in a mission. A mech camera starts on the same side; in any vehicle the swap key moves the camera from left to the middle to right.

option_list.description: Vertical field of view in a vehicle.

option_list.description: Enemies closer than this show on the ring; within half of it, the segment is stronger.

option_list.label: Hurt indicator
option_list.description: A bar near the crosshair points toward where a hit came from and fades within 2 seconds: red when health is lost, yellow when the personal shield takes it, white when the vehicle does. A bar for an enemy follows the enemy.

option_list.label: Hurt feedback
option_list.description: When the Helldiver loses health, the edges of the screen flash red and the camera shakes briefly, both stronger for a bigger hit. The shake follows the Camera shake option and shows in third person only.

option_list.label: Edge markers
option_list.description: In third person, stratagem beacons out of view show at the edge of the screen, with their own icons.

option_list.label: Compass
option_list.description: In third person, a compass at the top of the screen turns with the camera and shows the way to every objective found on the map.

option_list.label: Pings
option_list.description: In third person, the ping key marks what the crosshair is on: ground, an enemy, an objective or a dropped support weapon or pack. Teammates with the mod see the marker too and hear the chat sound; players without the mod see and hear nothing.

option_list.label: Throw arc
option_list.description: In third person, while a grenade or a stratagem ball is held, a dashed line shows the way it would fly if thrown now, and a ring where it first lands.

option_list.label: Names above heads
option_list.description: In third person, the name cards of players show above their heads instead of at their feet.

option_list.label: Reduce fog
option_list.description: How fast the fog of the level builds up with distance: 1 is the game's fog, 0.5 half as fast, 0 no fog at all. The fog still starts where it did, and the sun side of it is kept from glaring. In third person and in the top-down view. Photo Mode shows the full fog while it is open.

option_list.label: Depth of field
option_list.description: Game default keeps the blur of the planet. Focus on the Helldiver keeps the Helldiver sharp and blurs what lies a metre or more nearer or farther. Off keeps the whole picture sharp. Photo Mode sets the depth of field while open.

option_list.label: Long view distance
option_list.description: Pushes the far edge of the view and the detail of distant models out, so distant enemies and landmarks show. The fog is left to Reduce fog.

option_list.label: Sky
option_list.description: Draws a sky over the level for the time of the mission, dawn, day, dusk or night, instead of the smears the game leaves past the level: brighter toward the horizon, with the sun where the light of the level comes from, clouds, and stars and a moon at night. Needs a deploy.

option_list.label: Ballistics revamp
option_list.description: Every weapon reaches as far as the farthest one, so targets far off in the third-person view can be hit. Past a weapon's own range, bullets lose damage over 15 m, down to a fifth, and keep that fifth beyond. Lasers keep their damage. Changes the shared game: off in lobbies with players who don't run it.

option_list.label: Far enemy detection
option_list.description: Enemies notice and chase the squad from much farther away. Alarm range stays as in the game. Changes the shared game: off in lobbies with players who don't run it.

option_list.label: Free movement
option_list.description: In third person, the Helldiver is no longer held on the shared top-down screen with the squad. Changes the shared game: off in lobbies with players who don't run it.

option_list.label: Increased throw range
option_list.description: Grenades and stratagem balls fly twice as far, on top of the Strong Arm perk. Changes the shared game: off in lobbies with players who don't run it.

option_list.label: Patrols stay in view
option_list.description: The game removes a patrol a few seconds after it leaves the top-down screen and brings it back, climbing out of the ground or dropping in, when it comes close again. Patrols within 100 m of a Helldiver now stay. New patrols still arrive only at the edge of the top-down screen, as in the game. Changes the shared game: off in lobbies with players who don't run it.

mods.name: Custom Crosshair
mods.summary: Replaces the cursor with a customizable crosshair, with separate presets for idle and aiming. Also adds a hitmarker.
mods.description:
A crosshair mod for HELLDIVERS (2015), for the [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mod manager.

Custom Crosshair replaces the aim cursor with a crosshair built from shapes, with one look between shots and another while aiming. Shape, size, gap, color, outline and shadow are all settings. A hitmarker flashes around the crosshair, with a sound, when a shot from this player hurts or kills an enemy.

## How to use

The settings are in the Options tab of Custom Crosshair in Obsidian, with a live preview. A change applies at the next launch of the game.

With Eyes of Liberty, the crosshair goes where shots land. Turn off **Third person crosshair** to keep the crosshair of the game there instead, or **First person crosshair** for no crosshair in the first person camera of the Eyes of Liberty beta.

## Known issues

- On a controller the game shows no cursor in the top-down view, so no crosshair shows there.
- A shot that armor stops does not count as a hit.

option_list.description: Scales the shadow around the center of the crosshair. Below 1 the shadow shrinks inside the lines; above 1 it reaches past them.

option_list.label: Aiming shadow spread (px)
option_list.description: Widens the shadow by this many pixels on every side, on top of the outline width.

option_list.label: Aiming shadow blur (px)
option_list.description: Softens the shadow edge with fainter copies up to this many pixels out. 0 keeps a sharp edge.

option_list.label: Hitmarker
option_list.description: Shows four short diagonal lines around the crosshair on a hit, at full strength first, then fading out over the time set below.

option_list.label: Show on hits
option_list.description: Every hit that costs an enemy health shows the mark in the hit color.

option_list.label: Show on kills
option_list.description: A kill shows the mark in the kill color, over any hit mark still fading.

option_list.label: Hits from
option_list.description: Weapons in hand counts shots from the primary, the sidearm and the support weapon. Rockets, grenades, mines, sentries and stratagems count only with Everything.

option_list.label: Hit opacity
option_list.description: How strong a hit mark shows at first, before the fade. 1 is solid.

option_list.label: Kill opacity
option_list.description: How strong a kill mark shows at first, before the fade. 1 is solid.

option_list.label: Kill mark scale
option_list.description: A kill mark is this many times the size of a hit mark: line length, gap and thickness alike.

option_list.label: Hitmarker size (px)
option_list.description: Length of each line.

option_list.label: Hitmarker gap (px)
option_list.description: Distance from the center of the crosshair to the inner end of each line, along the diagonal.

option_list.label: Hitmarker thickness (px)
option_list.description: Width of the lines.

option_list.label: Hitmarker time (s)
option_list.description: How long a mark takes to fade out. A new hit starts the fade again.

option_list.label: Hitmarker outline
option_list.description: A black border one pixel wide, so the mark stands out on light ground.

option_list.label: Hitmarker sound
option_list.description: Plays a short sound with every mark the hitmarker shows, for hits and kills as set above.

option_list.label: Hitmarker sound volume
option_list.description: How loud the hitmarker sound plays. The volume settings of the game don't change it.

mods.name: Helldivers Arcade
mods.summary: Adds the ARCADE tab in the Galactic War terminal: alternate modes with transformative gameplay, separate from the main game.
mods.description:
Arcade game modes for HELLDIVERS (2015), for the [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mod manager. The first mode is Super Earth Survivors.

## Super Earth Survivors

A mode inspired by Vampire Survivors. The squad drops on an open map and holds out against waves that grow stronger over time. A second faction joins at 6 minutes and the third at 12, with elites, bosses and bombardments along the way.

Kills drop research samples. Each level up freezes the fight, refills health and lets every player pick one of three upgrade cards; every third level adds a stratagem. Some upgrades come in pairs that can evolve into a stronger one. The shuttle can be called after 15 minutes, and a summary of the run shows at the end.

## How to use

Open the galaxy map and pick the **ARCADE** tab, beside Proving Grounds. Choose the faction, the difficulty and the biome, then Launch. The next drop plays the same mission again until a campaign mission is picked.

Arcade missions leave the Galactic Campaign as it was.

## Playing with others

Until the host picks an arcade mission, the mod runs as a client mod and anyone can join. An arcade mission needs every player in the lobby to run Helldivers Arcade at the same version.

versions.notes: - Changed: a shorter description in Obsidian and the store.

- Changed: Helldivers Arcade is in Early Access, and the version numbers start again from 0.1.0. Installs of 1.3.0 or older are not offered this version as an update: remove the mod and install it again from the Store.

mods.name: Shared Resupply
mods.summary: Implements the Helldivers 2 resupply: 4 ammo boxes at a 180s cooldown. Box count and native resupply removal are configurable.
mods.description:
A mod for HELLDIVERS (2015) that brings the squad resupply from HELLDIVERS 2, for [Obsidian Mod Manager](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianModManager).

## What it does

Every player carries a yellow Resupply stratagem in every mission. It is listed with the mission stratagems (Reinforce, SOS Beacon, Hellbomb), on top of the four picks.

- Code: ↓ ↓ ↑ →.
- Drops one crate with four ammunition boxes (2 to 4 with the Ammo box count option).
- Call-in time is 10 seconds. No upgrades.
- Cooldown is 180 seconds and is shared by the whole squad: when anyone calls it, everyone waits. Players who join mid-mission take the squad's current cooldown.

The standard (blue) Resupply is removed from the Arsenal, the Loadout screen and loadouts.

## Options

- **Preserve vanilla Resupply** (off by default): keeps the standard Resupply in the Arsenal, the Loadout screen and loadouts. It then uses the code ↓ ↓ ↑ ↑.
- **Ammo box count** (4 by default): how many ammunition boxes the crate holds, from 2 to 4. The setting of the player who calls the Resupply decides.

## Playing with others

Every player in the lobby needs Shared Resupply, at the same version and with the same Preserve vanilla Resupply setting. Saved loadouts that held the standard Resupply get another stratagem in place of it, or keep it in the slot when no other stratagem fits; it is left out in missions.

Needs Obsidian API 1.40.0 or later.

option_list.label: Preserve vanilla Resupply

option_list.label: Ammo box count
option_list.description: How many ammo boxes the Resupply drops. The setting of the player who calls the Resupply decides.

- Fixed: with the standard Resupply removed, other players could see a loadout with the 4th stratagem slot empty. The fix comes with the next Obsidian API release.

- Changed: the stratagem icon has soft white bullets and a white plus on the standard yellow background.
- New: the stratagem icon is the picture Obsidian shows for the mod.

- New: shared Resupply mission stratagem, carried by every player.

- New: 180 second cooldown shared by the squad, kept by players who join mid-mission.
- New: standard Resupply removed from the Arsenal and loadouts, with the Preserve vanilla Resupply option to keep it.
